scope: Gate comparison only; no chord/style/query enumeration, harmonic requirements, bass constraints, root requirements, deduplication or ranking membership claimed. Strict mute has no matching comparator semantics.

conventions.thumb_source: evaluateHandPlayability destructuring default is false; both generator implementations pass optional flag unchanged
conventions.S: All stopped fret crowns, including an allocated thumb if enabled; opens and omitted strings excluded
conventions.p5: monotonic OR (G <= 4 AND S <= 95); common hand gate applied separately
conventions.evaluator_role: Exact engineering comparator output, never physical ground truth

cases.expectation: Adjacent G-to-B pitch inversion with two stopped contacts in an upper position; hypothesized within the coarse group/span envelope.
Downward translation of A01 preserves pitch ordering but enlarges millimeter span; hypothesized beyond the coarse span envelope.
Adjacent bass-string pitch inversion with two stopped contacts high on the neck; hypothesized within the coarse group/span envelope.
Downward translation of A03 preserves pitch ordering but enlarges millimeter span; hypothesized beyond the coarse span envelope.
A-to-D pitch inversion plus a remote high-E contact; three stops and upper-position spacing hypothesized within the coarse envelope.
Downward translation of A05 preserves pitch ordering but enlarges millimeter span; hypothesized beyond the coarse span envelope.
Stopped bass string sounds above adjacent open A; one stopped contact suggests coarse acceptance but open-string clearance still requires attention.
Stopped G sounds above adjacent open B while high E rings; one stopped contact suggests coarse acceptance with clearance requirements.
Bass pitch inversion and six distinct stopped frets within an upper-position cluster; hypothesized group-count exclusion despite comparatively narrow span.
Upward translation of A09 further reduces physical span while retaining six distinct frets; hypothesized group-count exclusion.
Repeated pitch inversions with alternating fret masks; lower full barre and three higher contacts suggest a four-group representation within coarse span.
Two separated adjacent-string pitch inversions with four stops and an internal omitted string; hypothesized low group count within coarse span, with omission distinct from compulsory damping.

microbenchmark.limitation: Sequential warmed microbenchmark cycles fixed fixtures. Includes per-call timer overhead. Does not measure full generator search or physical accuracy.
